function.arguments: {"observation": "93 rows have biomarker_baseline = -999, which is a sentinel value indicating missing or invalid data.", "implication": "This is a systematic missingness pattern. The analysis must account for this — either by excluding these rows or imputing. We must check if the missingness is balanced across arms."}
function.name: note_finding
